blocks.text: CLEANOUT FAQ
Cleanout Services in Ajax — Deadline Questions, Dependable Answers

items.q: How much do cleanout services cost in Ajax?
a: Truck volume decides: small cleanouts from $125, whole homes scaling openly with what their contents fill. The exact figure is written free at the walkthrough — sorting, carrying, hauling and every disposal fee inside — and neither the number nor the completion date moves after approval.

items.q: Can you guarantee the house is empty by our closing date?
a: That’s the service Ajax knows us for. The cleanout books backward from closing with margin built in, progress tracks daily on bigger homes, and the property hands over broom-swept before the keys change hands. Tell us the date at the walkthrough and the plan is built to beat it.

items.q: What if our closing moves up?
a: Call us the moment you know. With crews running seven days, 6AM–11PM, schedules compress far more easily than most expect — and because the quote is flat, a tighter timeline never becomes a bigger bill.

items.q: How do you handle estate cleanouts with family involved?
a: At the family’s pace, inside the timeline. The keep-list comes first, meaningful finds come to you mid-clear rather than a bin, and executors or out-of-town relatives get updates and documentation without needing to stand in the driveway. Present, occasional or entirely hands-off — all three work.

items.q: What happens when you find valuables or documents?
a: They go straight to you or the executor, without exception. Cash in pockets, papers in drawers, jewellery in the strangest places — cleanouts surface all of it, and our crews are trained to slow down precisely there.

items.q: Is the hoarding cleanout truly discreet?
a: Truly. Unmarked scheduling on request, no commentary, no photos beyond what you ask for, and a respectful room-by-room pace. Ajax neighbours learn nothing from us — that discretion is much of why we’re referred.

items.q: Where do the belongings end up?
a: Donation first: furniture, housewares and clothing to charity partners; metals, appliances and e-waste to licensed recyclers; landfill strictly last. The split can be documented for estate files, landlords or your own records.
